title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Digital Marketing Executive

North Bristol £33,000-£36,000 per annum Office-based, 5 days per week

We're looking for a hungry, proactive and commercially minded Digital Marketing Executive to join an established and successful independent business in Bristol.

The role is ultimately about driving more visitors, increasing sales and helping the business grow through effective, engaging marketing. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of a broad mix of digital and traditional activity and see the direct impact of your work.

This is a hands-on role covering digital marketing, social media, content, e-commerce, SEO, email marketing, campaigns and analytics.

The Person we're looking for

You won't necessarily have experience across every area of digital marketing, and that's absolutely fine. We're more interested in your attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn than ticking every box.

You'll be someone who is happy to research, teach yourself new skills and find solutions when you come across something you haven't done before. You'll have a solid grounding in marketing and digital, but we're open to someone whose experience is stronger in some areas than others and who is keen to develop.

We're looking for someone who is resourceful, self-motivated and confident working autonomously, who takes ownership, gets things done and understands that great marketing should deliver commercial results.

If you're excited by the opportunity to broaden your skills, contribute ideas and make a visible difference, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing
- Managing and developing website and e-commerce content
- Creating engaging social media and digital content
- Supporting SEO and paid digital activity
- Planning and delivering email marketing campaigns
- Supporting seasonal campaigns, promotions and events
- Using analytics and reporting to understand performance
- Helping to improve the customer journey and online experience
- Supporting traditional marketing activity including print, advertising and promotional materials
- Working with colleagues and external suppliers to deliver marketing activity

What We're Looking For

You'll ideally have experience or knowledge in some of the following:
- Digital marketing and social media
- Content creation
- SEO and website management
- E-commerce
- Email marketing
- Google Analytics and Google Search Console
- Google Ads
- Canva

You do not need to have experience in all of these areas. A strong marketing foundation, digital confidence and a willingness to learn are more important.

What's On Offer
- £33,000-£36,000 per annum, depending on experience
- A varied role with genuine ownership
- The opportunity to broaden and develop your digital marketing skills
- A supportive and collaborative working environment
- Generous holiday allowance
- A range of company benefits

If you're a self-motivated marketer who is curious, capable and keen to keep learning, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Marketing and Creative Lead
description:
At Hft, our vision is to create a future where learning disabled people can live the best life possible.

We campaign for positive change, provide personalised support and create solutions that enable people to live independently. Our marketing plays an important role in helping us tell that story, connect with new audiences and inspire people to support the work we do.

We're looking for a Marketing and Creative Lead to bring creativity, insight and energy to our fundraising campaigns and digital communications.

About the role

This is a hands-on role where creativity meets data and purpose. Working closely with our Fundraising and External Communications teams, you'll develop and deliver engaging, integrated marketing campaigns that reach new and existing audiences, build supporter relationships and inspire people to get behind Hft's work.

You'll take ownership of key marketing moments throughout the year, including Learning Disability Week and our Christmas campaign, while also helping us continually improve how we engage audiences across digital channels.

We're looking for someone who can come up with a great creative idea - but who also wants to understand why it works, who it reaches and how we can make it even better.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Developing and delivering creative, evidence-led integrated marketing campaigns across paid and owned channels.
- Working closely with Fundraising colleagues to identify opportunities where marketing can have the greatest impact.
- Leading key campaign and engagement moments, creating compelling content across websites, social media, email and other digital channels.
- Developing creative assets using tools such as Canva, ensuring activity is engaging, accessible and on-brand.
- Maintaining and applying Hft's brand guidelines and tone of voice across marketing activity.
- Creating content that brings our work to life and showcases the difference Hft makes.
- Working with colleagues across Care & Support to identify powerful stories and ensure the voices of the people we support are authentically represented.
- Planning, creating and managing engaging digital content, including social media, video, graphics and photography.
- Developing audience-led email campaigns, newsletters and automated communications.
- Using CRM insight and audience data to create more personalised and relevant communications.
- Supporting the development and optimisation of digital supporter journeys to strengthen engagement and long-term supporter relationships.
- Planning, managing and optimising paid social, PPC and Google Ads campaigns.
- Developing audience targeting and retargeting approaches to support awareness, engagement, supporter acquisition and fundraising.
- Monitoring campaign performance and budgets, using data to test, learn and continuously improve results.
- Managing Hft's photo library, ensuring appropriate permissions, data protection and training are in place.
- Ensuring all marketing content is accurate, accessible, inclusive, safeguarding-conscious and consistent with Hft's brand.

About you

We're looking for a creative and digitally savvy marketer who enjoys turning ideas into campaigns that make a difference.

You'll have significant experience in digital marketing and communications, ideally within a fundraising, charity or purpose-led environment, and a proven ability to develop, deliver and evaluate successful campaigns.
- Developing and delivering integrated digital marketing campaigns.
- Managing social media channels and developing effective social media strategies.
- Creating engaging digital content, including video, graphics and photography.
- Writing and editing compelling content for different audiences and digital channels.
- Email marketing, audience segmentation and supporter journeys.
- Website management, SEO and digital user experience.
- Planning and optimising paid digital campaigns, including paid social, PPC and Google Ads.
- Using creative tools such as Canva to produce high-quality marketing materials.
- Using audience insight, CRM data and campaign performance to inform decision-making.
- Managing multiple projects and priorities within agreed deadlines.

You'll be highly organised, proactive and comfortable working at pace. You'll be someone who can take an idea from concept through to delivery, while remaining curious about what the data is telling you and always looking for ways to improve.

You'll also be a strong collaborator who enjoys working with different teams, building relationships and bringing people together around a shared objective.

Why join Hft?

This is an opportunity to use your marketing and creative skills for a purpose that really matters.

You'll have the opportunity to:
- Shape high-profile fundraising campaigns and key moments in Hft's calendar.
- Develop creative work that reaches new audiences and inspires people to support our cause.
- Use data and insight to test ideas and directly influence campaign performance.
- Work across digital, creative, fundraising and communications.
- Help tell the stories of the people we support and showcase the impact of Hft's work.
- Bring new ideas and creativity to how we engage our audiences.
- Be part of a collaborative team committed to creating positive change.

Working arrangements

This is a national hybrid role with travel to Hft services and other locations across the organisation.

Recruitment Process

Applications close on: 2nd November 2026

Following your application, you'll have an initial pre-screen call with a member of our Recruitment team before progressing to the formal interview stage.

Interviews will take place via Microsoft Teams, with the Hiring Manager and a member of Hft's Executive Team.

Hft is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process where required.

title: Senior Internal Communications Manager
description:
At Hft, our vision is to create a future where learning disabled people can live the best life possible. We do this by coming together to campaign for positive change, provide personalised support and create solutions for living independently.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Internal Communications Manager to join our People & Culture team and lead our internal communications agenda across Hft on a 12 month FTC.

This role is to commence the week commencing 7 December

About the role

This is a strategic and hands-on role where you'll play a key part in keeping our colleagues informed, engaged and connected to our purpose, values and priorities.

Working closely with our CEO, Chief People Officer, Executive Team and senior leaders, you'll shape and deliver high-impact communications that reach colleagues across the organisation - from corporate teams to our frontline workforce.

You'll take ownership of our internal communications channels and content, including our Hub, internal social media, e-newsletters, campaigns and colleague events. You'll also play a central role in our Big Conversation, creating opportunities for colleagues to have their voices heard and helping leaders communicate clearly, consistently and authentically.

What you'll be doing
- Lead Hft's internal communications strategy, ensuring activity is aligned with our organisational priorities, vision and values.
- Develop and deliver engaging, accessible communications and campaigns on behalf of the Executive Team and senior leaders.
- Build strong, two-way communication with colleagues, creating opportunities for feedback, dialogue and colleague voice.
- Own and develop our internal communications channels, including the Hub, newsletters, internal social media and corporate content.
- Establish a clear internal communications calendar and ensure activity is well planned, coordinated and joined up.
- Develop and embed a distinctive Hft tone of voice and communications framework.
- Support leaders and managers to communicate effectively through training, guidance and practical toolkits.
- Use data, insight and feedback to measure the effectiveness of communications and continually improve our approach.
- Create engaging content across a range of formats, including written communications, presentations, video, graphics and campaigns.
- Work closely with our External Communications and People teams to ensure messaging is consistent and opportunities to engage colleagues are maximised.
- Lead and support the development of the Internal Communications Officer, creating a positive environment for performance, wellbeing and professional development.
- Manage sensitive and high-profile communications, using sound judgement and awareness of reputational risk.
- Support employee engagement activity and help turn colleague feedback into meaningful action.

About you

You'll be an experienced internal communications professional who can combine strategic thinking with excellent delivery skills.

You'll be a confident writer and communicator, able to take complex information and turn it into clear, engaging and accessible messages for different audiences. You'll be comfortable working with senior leaders, influencing stakeholders and advising on the best way to communicate important or sensitive messages.

We're particularly interested in people who have experience of:
- Delivering internal communications and engagement across a dispersed or remote workforce.
- Developing communication strategies and advising senior stakeholders.
- Managing multiple communication channels and measuring their effectiveness.
- Building colleague engagement through creative and innovative communications.
- Using data and insight to shape communications and demonstrate impact.
- Designing and delivering communications training for managers and leaders.
- Managing sensitive communications and reputational risk.
- Working collaboratively across complex or matrix-style organisations.

You'll be creative, solutions-focused and proactive, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities. Most importantly, you'll be someone who understands that great internal communications are about more than simply sharing information - they're about creating connection, building trust and making sure every colleague feels informed and heard.

Why join Hft?

You'll have the opportunity to make a genuine difference to how our colleagues experience Hft and how connected they feel to our purpose.

You'll join a collaborative People & Culture team and have the opportunity to shape and evolve our internal communications approach at an important time for the organisation.

Working arrangements

This is a national hybrid role with regular travel to Hft services and other locations across the organisation.

Recruitment Process

Applications close on: 3rd November 2026 . Following your application, you'll have an initial pre-screen call with a member of our Recruitment team before progressing to the formal interview stage.

Interviews will take place via Microsoft Teams, with the Hiring Manager and a member of Hft's Executive Team.

Hft is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process where required.

title: Social Media and Content Executive
company: Moxie and Mettle Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Social Media & Content Executive

Bristol

£30k-£35k

We're looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media & Content Executive to join a family-owned property business in Bristol.

This is a varied role where you'll take ownership of the company's social media and content, while supporting wider marketing activity designed to drive enquiries, strengthen the brand and raise the company's profile within the property market.

This is a standalone marketing role, so we're looking for someone who is confident working independently and taking ownership. You'll need to be self-sufficient, proactive and full of ideas, able to spot opportunities, decide what needs doing and get on with it rather than waiting for direction. We're looking for someone who will bring energy and creativity to the role, constantly looking for what could be done next, how things can be improved and new ways to engage and grow the audience

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Managing Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and LinkedIn
- Creating engaging photo, video and written content
- Managing property listings across relevant property platforms
- Creating property descriptions, campaigns, blogs and promotional content
- Supporting lead generation and improving enquiry conversion
- Working with external SEO, content and paid advertising specialists
- Monitoring marketing performance, analytics and ROI
- Creating testimonials, case studies and other brand content
- Building relationships with relevant partners and local organisations
- Keeping an eye on competitor activity, pricing and market trends

About You

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience in social media, content or digital marketing who is confident at taking ownership and getting things done.

You'll need:
- Strong social media, copywriting and content creation skills
- Good photography and videography skills
- A creative eye and confidence creating content for different platforms
- A commercial mindset and understanding of lead generation
- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently
- Basic Canva or Adobe skills

Experience in property, student marketing or another consumer-facing sector would be useful but not essential.

Knowledge of the Bristol market and local scene, including universities, communities and local businesses, would also be an advantage.

The Person

You'll be proactive, creative and commercially minded, with plenty of initiative and a genuine interest in creating great content.

This is a small, close-knit business, so we're looking for someone who is hands-on, personable and happy to get stuck in.

The role is predominantly office-based in Bristol, ideally five days a week, with the possibility of one day working from home.

Bristol £30k-£35k Full-time
